qualification: Existing Roku request/profile emulation, real backend and gateway, trusted HTTPS, paced independent output decoding. Physical Roku rendering is not asserted.
limitations: Paced decoder progress gaps are recorded as performance failures; browser rendering is measured separately.
External network timings are functional observations, not controlled before/after performance gains.
Dolby Vision coverage verifies compatible HDR10 base-layer conversion, not dynamic Dolby Vision processing.
Every failed attempt is retained; post-campaign retries do not overwrite primary failures.
